readout_other: DTI FA and MD (3 T RESOLVE); T2WI edema volume; neuroscore; Nissl and HE staining
direction_notes: Neural excitability was not assessed; LITUS-treated TBI rats had altered FA and MD time courses, smaller edema volume, better neuroscore and Nissl staining than untreated TBI rats.

timing.protocol_description: Unfocused transducer collimated to the rat brain; total stimulation of 10 min with 200 trials, once a day for 42 days after CCI. FF 500 kHz, PRF 1 kHz, SD 400 ms, TBD 0.5 ms.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Rats in the LITUS treatment group (n = 15) received the same operation.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: After the CCI operation, the rats were then treated with LITUS stimulation once a day for 42 days.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The ultrasound fundamental frequency (FF) and pulse repetition frequency (PRF) were 500 and 1 kHz, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The ultrasound fundamental frequency (FF) and pulse repetition frequency (PRF) were 500 and 1 kHz, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The ultrasound stimulation duration (SD) and tone-burst duration (TBD) parameters were 400 and 0.5 ms, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The ultrasound stimulation duration (SD) and tone-burst duration (TBD) parameters were 400 and 0.5 ms, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.isppa_w_: The ultrasound pressure was measured by a calibrated needle-type hydrophone (HNR500, Onda, Sunnyvale, CA, United States), and the spatial peak and pulse-average intensity (Isppa) was 2.6 W/cm2.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: As shown in Figure 1, two function generators (AFG3022C; Tektronix, United States) were used to generate ultrasonic pulse signals, which were then amplified by power amplifiers (E&I240 L; ENI Inc., United States) and transmitted to ultrasonic transducers (V301-SU; Olympus, Japan).
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: As shown in Figure 1, two function generators (AFG3022C; Tektronix, United States) were used to generate ultrasonic pulse signals, which were then amplified by power amplifiers (E&I240 L; ENI Inc., United States) and transmitted to ultrasonic transducers (V301-SU; Olympus, Japan).

flags.reason: 45 rats enrolled (15 sham, 15 TBI, 15 LITUS); only the 15 LITUS rats were sonicated.
Text reads "400 and 0.5 ms" for SD and TBD; units read as ms for SD (400 ms) by order; 0.5 ms TBD.
Target is only "the rat brain"; stimulation position shown in Fig. 1B.
Sham Control rats had scalp incision and drilling without CCI or LITUS; the TBI group had CCI without LITUS. No ultrasound sham arm.
Only the radiologists measuring FA/MD were stated as blinded to grouping.
Isppa from hydrophone-calibrated pressure; medium not stated.
Anaesthesia during LITUS sessions not stated; pentobarbital used for surgery and MR scans.
